The Catalogue

    How to use this catalogue

    1. Tap a brand to open its full collection.
    2. Type in the search bar — a reference, model, colour or size. It stays at the top while you scroll.
    3. Use Filter to narrow by collection, dial, case colour, movement or size, and Sort to reorder.
    4. Tap any watch for its full specifications and other colourways.
    5. Tap + on two or three watches, then Compare to see the differences side by side.
    6. Open HOROLOGY LAB to see each movement, its interactive manual, and every model that uses it.
    7. Use Copy reference to paste the exact code into a message or order.

    Save it to your phone

    Scan the code with your phone camera to open the catalogue, then save it to your home screen.

    iPhone

    1. Open the link in Safari.
    2. Tap Share (the square with an arrow).
    3. Tap Add to Home Screen, name it “ILG Catalogue”, then tap Add.

    Android

    1. Open the link in Chrome.
    2. Tap the ⋮ menu at the top right.
    3. Tap Add to Home screen (or Install app), then Add.

    Nothing is installed from an app store. The icon opens this page, asks for no permissions and cannot read your photos, contacts or files. Only scan the official ILG Academy code.
